A Space in the Application Design Center.

## Example Usage - Designcenter Space Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_space" "example" {
  project                     = "my-project-name"
  location                    = "us-central1"
  space_id                    = "example-space"
  display_name                = "Example Design Center Space"
  description                 = "Managed by Terraform"
  enable_gcp_shared_templates = true
}

resource "google_design_center_catalog" "example" {
  project      = google_design_center_space.example.project
  location     = google_design_center_space.example.location
  space        = google_design_center_space.example.space_id
  catalog_id   = "example-catalog"
  display_name = "Example Catalog"
  description  = "Catalog of approved architectural templates"
}

resource "google_design_center_catalog_template" "example" {
  project             = google_design_center_space.example.project
  location            = google_design_center_space.example.location
  space               = google_design_center_space.example.space_id
  catalog             = google_design_center_catalog.example.catalog_id
  catalog_template_id = "example-template"
  display_name        = "Example Component Template"
  description         = "Example Catalog Template Description"
  template_category   = "COMPONENT_TEMPLATE"
}

resource "google_design_center_application_template" "example" {
  project                 = google_design_center_space.example.project
  location                = google_design_center_space.example.location
  space                   = google_design_center_space.example.space_id
  application_template_id = "example-app-template"
  display_name            = "Example Application Template"
  description             = "Application template with compliance policy"
}

resource "google_design_center_policy" "example" {
  project              = google_design_center_space.example.project
  location             = google_design_center_space.example.location
  space                = google_design_center_space.example.space_id
  application_template = google_design_center_application_template.example.application_template_id
  policy_id            = "example-policy"
  display_name         = "Example Compliance Policy"
  description          = "Example Policy Description"
  policy_type          = "COMPLIANCE_FRAMEWORK"
  policy_uri           = "organizations/123456789/locations/global/frameworks/cis-gcp-v2"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the space.

* `space_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the space.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  The display name of the space.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  The description of the space.

* `enable_gcp_shared_templates` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to enable GCP shared templates.

* `gcs_bucket` -
  (Optional)
  The GCS bucket for the space.

* `tags` -
  (Optional)
  Tags for the space.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the space.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the space was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the space was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Space can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Space using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_space.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Space using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_space.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Space can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_space.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_space.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_space.default {{location}}/{{space_id}}
```
